_comment: Plain-text shape of the wwexecution secure.config role / permission map.
Encrypt this JSON with the Warewolf encryption tool before deploying:
Each WindowsGroupPermission row maps a group (or UPN) to a workflow.
IsServer == true  + ResourceID empty   --> server-wide permission
IsServer == false + ResourceName set   --> per-workflow permission
WorkflowAuthorizationMiddleware uses these rules at runtime:
1. Group OR check  - caller must match at least one WindowsGroup entry.
2. Permission AND check - matched entry must hold ALL required flags.
Default required = View | Execute (set in WorkflowAuthPolicyLoader).

WindowsGroupPermissions._comment: Admins must also have a per-workflow entry to execute it. WorkflowAuthPolicyLoader excludes IsServer=true rows from per-workflow policies (those govern apis.json visibility only).
PUBLIC group - View only on the order workflow
wwusers group - can View+Execute the sales workflow

Warewolf_ClientApps - app-only client apps (e.g. the AzureFunction example's Managed Identity). WindowsGroup must equal the sanitized Entra app-role value carried in the token's roles claim; the app role is created from the GroupPermissions key in Deploy-WwExecutionEngine.authconfig.json and assigned to the client SP by Configure-WwExecutionAuth-Clients.ps1 -AppRolesToAssign.
wwoperators group - can View+Execute the getdata workflow
